summary: The grubslot, partition and devfs host tests on the boot loader's window, with faults in utils/grubslot.c and the kernel's partition and devfs code

argv:
set -e
t=${WORK}/tree
rm -rf "$t"
mkdir -p "$t/rach2" "$t/tests/host"
cp -R rach2/sys "$t/rach2/sys"
cp -R utils "$t/utils"
cp -R tests/host/compat "$t/tests/host/compat"
cp tests/host/grubslot_hosttest.c tests/host/partition_hosttest.c tests/host/devfs_hosttest.c "$t/tests/host/"
cp -R ${SRC}/. "$t/"
cd "$t"
for x in grubslot_hosttest partition_hosttest devfs_hosttest; do
    deps=$(grep -oE 'host-deps:[^*]*' tests/host/$x.c | sed 's/host-deps://' | tr '\n' ' ')
    ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/arch/x86 -I rach2/sys/arch/i686 -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -I utils -I ${TREE}/krffs -I tests/host/compat -o ${WORK}/$x tests/host/$x.c $deps
done

r=0
s=0
${WORK}/grubslot_hosttest || s=$?
[ "$s" -eq 0 ] || [ "$s" -ge 128 ] || s=1
[ "$s" -le "$r" ] || r=$s
s=0
${WORK}/partition_hosttest || s=$?
[ "$s" -eq 0 ] || [ "$s" -ge 128 ] || s=1
[ "$s" -le "$r" ] || r=$s
s=0
${WORK}/devfs_hosttest || s=$?
[ "$s" -eq 0 ] || [ "$s" -ge 128 ] || s=1
[ "$s" -le "$r" ] || r=$s
exit $r

faults.name: tails
faults.summary: the window's tails taken as the gap's constant, whatever the window is

faults.name: bound
faults.summary: a candidate judged against the longest tail, not this window's

faults.name: active
faults.summary: a running image judged against the longest tail, not this window's

lines: an image longer than the partition's tail

faults.name: other-array
faults.summary: the unread copy's entry array forgotten

lines: though the primary never read that array

faults.name: one-entry
faults.summary: the first BIOS boot partition taken where a second makes it unclear

lines: since which one is meant is not known

faults.name: own-array
faults.summary: the serving header's own entry array forgotten

lines: an entry over the primary array is no window

faults.name: past-disk
faults.summary: a partition past the disk's end published all the same

lines: nor one whose partition runs past the disk
